name: Axiom Puzzle Lab
description: Sixteen modern visual problem-solving games in one sleek studio — Traffic Escape, Laser Mirrors, Flow Connect, Color Flask Sort, Pipe Plumber, Untangle Web, Crate Mover, Ice Labyrinth, Shape Fit, One-Stroke Path, Circuit Lab, Matchstick Fix, Detective Grid, Safe Cracker, Mine Sweep, and Sudoku.
